test_discussionReactions
TestUserDiscussionReactions
Given I logged into web app as a user, when I do not have any discussions, then I should see an empty discussions page
Given there are discussion posts, when I view this post with none reacting, then I should see Like button in Greyed out state
Given there are discussion posts, when I try to react to this post by giving thumbs up, then I should see Like button changing to Blue colour with text==Like
Given there are discussion posts with reactions==Like by logged in user, then 'No reactions yet' text should be changed to 'You reacted' with reacted emoji

Given there are discussion posts with reactions==Like by logged in user, when I click on 'You reacted' section, then I should see a modal with all reactions details such as 'All' count, count by 'emojis', users who reacted with what emojis
Given there are discussion posts, when I try to hover over Like button, then I should see all the available list of emojis

Given there are discussion posts with reactions==Like by logged in user, when I try to update the reaction with other emojis such as 'Clap' by hovering over the Like button, then I should see the Like text changing to 'Clap' and You reacted section
Given there are discussion posts with reactions done by user, when I logged into coach portal and visit this user posts, then coach should be able to see posts with user reactions
Given there are discussion posts with reactions done by user, when I logged into coach portal and visit this user posts, then coach should be able to add reactions to this post successfully

Given there are discussion posts with reactions done by user and coach, when user logged into web portal and visits the post, then user should be able to see all reactions including coach's reactions and 'You reacted' text changing to 'You and 1 other' with respective emojis
test_guided_tour
TestGuidedTour
Guided Tour Welcome: Clicking 'Maybe Later' should open final guidance message and allow finishing back to dashboard targets
Guided Tour End-to-End: User can progress through every tour step with Next and finish successfully on dashboard
Guided Tour Navigation Controls: Back and Next should preserve correct step content and still allow successful completion
Guided Tour Skip Behavior: Skipping from each intermediate step should jump to final message and support successful finish
Guided Tour Welcome UI: Initial modal should show Habi welcome, Maybe Later and Take a Tour buttons, and language switch
Guided Tour Step 1 UI: Social communication step should display exact message with Skip Tour and Next controls
Guided Tour Step 2 UI: Discussion board step should show exact guidance text with Back, Next, and Skip Tour buttons
Guided Tour Step 3 UI: Meal logging step should render exact instructional text with navigation controls
Guided Tour Step 4 UI: Weight tracking step should display exact copy and provide Back, Next, and Skip Tour options
Guided Tour Step 5 UI: Exercise tracking step should present exact message and all expected navigation actions
Guided Tour Step 6 UI: Device sync step should show exact Fitbit/Garmin/Apple Watch guidance with proper controls
Guided Tour Final Step UI: Completion message should hide Skip Tour, keep Back and Finish visible, and return to dashboard after finish

test_talktomycoach
TestDashboardChat
TC01 – Verify the chat bubble icon is visible on the dashboard home page after login
TC02 – Verify the chat bubble dropdown displays all three options: Talk To My Coach, Talk To My Team, and View My Meetings
TC03 – Verify clicking Talk To My Coach from the dropdown opens the coach chat modal
TC04 – Verify the coach chat modal header displays the correct title: Talk To Your Coach
TC05 – Verify the message input box is visible inside the coach modal and accepts text input
TC06 – Verify the send arrow button is visible and in an enabled clickable state inside the coach modal
TC07 – Verify the X close button is visible and in an enabled clickable state inside the coach modal
TC08 – Verify that typing a message in the input box and pressing Enter sends the message and clears the input field
TC09 – Verify that clicking the X close button dismisses and hides the coach chat modal
TC10 – Full end-to-end flow: open coach modal, send a dynamic test message via button, verify it appears in chat, confirm input clears, and close the modal
TC11 – Verify that typing only spaces in the message input and pressing Enter does not send a message and the chat remains unchanged
TC12 – Verify that a message containing emojis can be typed, sent successfully, and appears in the chat conversation
TC13 – Verify that a message containing special characters is accepted, sent successfully, and appears correctly in the chat conversation
TC15 – Verify that pressing Enter on a completely empty input field does not send a message and the chat conversation remains unchanged
TC16 – Verify that multiple consecutive messages sent one after another all appear correctly in the chat conversation in order
TC17 – Verify that messages sent in the coach chat are persisted and remain visible after the page is refreshed and the user logs back in
TC18 – Verify that a sent message appears instantly in the chat conversation within 2 seconds of being submitted
TC19 – Verify that a very long message of approximately 1000 characters is accepted, sent, and displayed in the chat without breaking the modal UI layout
TC20 – Verify that the chat modal maintains smooth scrolling performance when a large number of messages are present in the conversation
TC21 – Verify that a vertical scrollbar appears in the chat messages area when the number of messages exceeds the visible screen height of the modal
TC21A – Verify that sending a very long paragraph message causes the chat area to scroll but does not break the modal UI layout
TC22 – Verify that the user avatar or initials icon is displayed correctly next to messages in the coach chat conversation
TC23 – Verify that clicking outside the coach chat modal on the weekly meals section does not close the modal and it remains fully visible and intact
TC24 – Verify that each chat message displays a timestamp
TC25 – Verify reopening chat retains previous messages
